cells.text: Two answers written independently, compared by code, judged by Max at named gates. Every step leaves a file Max can audit.

Max asks a question
(metric, population, period)

Max decides at gates
approve - freeze the card - confirm tables - accept differences - rename

Skills propose
draft the card, shortlist tables, write query B, explain results

Scripts decide
split, run one step at a time, compare, sample, test; exit code is the verdict

Hooks guard
read-only warehouse identity, byte cap, no writes outside scratch, scrubbed spawns

Audit folder
one CSV per step, manifest, checks, report; kept until the retention date

Whole A
written blind by the Codex seat or by Max

Warehouse
BigQuery first; read-only principal; pinned to one point in time

Independent reference
GL or control total

Verdict to Max
verified - reconciled - consistent - not reconciled
(wording fixed by independence, pin status, reference)

Why two answers: comparing a query against its own split caught 0 of 9 planted faults; comparing against an independently written whole caught 9 of 9. Without an independent reference the strongest verdict is reconciled, never verified.
Colour: yellow = a person decides. blue = a skill proposes, never passes or fails. green = code decides. orange = hooks. purple = outside the plugin. dashed = audit record.
